reply_text:
I've answered Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 set Quarrendon Freight Lines at **185 seats**. It was signed 2025-08-19 and took effect 2025-09-01.

- **Why 185, not 180:** Dana first posted 180 in #north-team on Aug 20, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. The amendment text agrees with 185. She's a member of #north-team, so she can see that thread herself.
- **Heads-up I added for the deck:** Amendment No. 3 was signed 2026-09-22 and raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. If the QBR looks at 2027, 185 won't be the current number.
- **What I left out:** I didn't share any money terms (rates, discounts, ARR, invoicing), only seat counts and dates. A seat count is an operational fact, and Dana is on the North team that handles this account, so no approval was needed.

I didn't confuse it with Quarendon Freightways, which is a different company and not a customer.
